data.rationale: The proposal matches the true four-stage flow (Flights, Booking, Viator, Notes) and the note format. It leaves out the 8+ review-score rule, the consent "Reject all" step, the "New note" click and the do-not-click constraints. It also uses a vague "{landmark} tour" query and no activity parameter, and it says "best/cheapest" and "top hotel" where the true workflow says first flight and first hotel scoring 8 or more, so an automation would need guessing.
